production_changes_made.problem: both_maps_share_exact_frame compared the manifest's declared CRS string against the map's normalized PROJ.4 string. An EPSG code never equals a PROJ string, so the check was structurally incapable of returning True, and it also never checked the manifest against itself.
production_changes_made.evidence: test_new295_coordinate_frame_binding failed with both_maps_share_exact_frame False for two identical '+proj=utm +zone=32 ...' georeferences and a manifest declaring EPSG:25832. test_new295_wrong_crs_fails passed 'valid' for a manifest declaring EPSG:32633 while carrying zone-32 PROJ parameters.
production_changes_made.fix: Added canonical_crs_identity() resolving EPSG codes and PROJ strings to a canonical EPSG (lazy pyproj, None = fail-closed). Frame sharing and both transform digests now compare resolved identity. validate_frame_binding rejects unresolvable CRS, manifest crs/geo_reference disagreement, and per-arm georeference/CRS mismatch.
production_changes_made.classification: PRODUCTION_DEFECT_FIX (pre-existing on Candidate A, not introduced by integration)

production_changes_made.problem: _select_capture_profile_items returned every calibration LiDAR entry, so an inactive entry (middle_lidar_old) reached spawn_rig's LiDAR loop and hit NEW-301's own 'not in canonical active spec' RuntimeError, aborting the entire rig. A historical calibration leftover therefore prevented the governed rig from existing.
production_changes_made.fix: Spawn set is filtered to the canonical active LiDAR set. If no active LiDAR resolves, raise sensor_spawn_missing_required_modalities:lidar (fail-closed).

production_changes_made.problem: NEW-299 required a hashable runtime rig identity, but canonical_lidar_hash was imported and unused; spawn_rig produced no identity, so capture evidence could not prove which sensors/attributes actually existed.
production_changes_made.fix: Added runtime_rig_identity(spawned) building a content hash over spawned sensor names, kinds and effective attributes plus the canonical LiDAR spec hash; recorded at the end of spawn_rig. Inactive calibration entries provably cannot affect it (test asserts identity is unchanged when an inactive entry is mutated).

production_changes_made.problem: resolve_active_lidars(data, ...) referenced an undefined name; load_calib returns (cams, lids). The NEW-301 canonical path would raise NameError at runtime.
production_changes_made.fix: Read the calibration document explicitly as calib_data and pass it to resolve_active_lidars.

production_changes_made.problem: A missing required active LiDAR produced a warning at most, so a rig could be reported ok with zero LiDARs attached, invalidating every downstream perception claim.
production_changes_made.fix: required_active_lidar_missing_from_calibration is appended to report['errors'], which drives ok=False.

production_changes_made.problem: The module was a script masquerading as library code: it read calib_data.json from the current working directory and executed comparisons at import time, and it self-imported (import ultimate_pipeline.sensors.rig_transforms as rt). It also reimplemented attachment-pose math, competing with transform_conventions. This violated the requirement that importing a supported sensor module have no cwd-dependent execution side effects.
production_changes_made.callers_audited: git grep for imports: zero production importers. Only the file's own self-import and one historical report mention (tools/calib_sanity_check.py:12 refers to it in prose only).
production_changes_made.fix: Relocated out of the sensors package into ultimate_pipeline/tools/, rewritten to delegate to transform_conventions (the real pose authority), with a main() guard and an explicit CLI argument instead of a cwd-relative read.
production_changes_made.classification: DEAD_BROKEN_CODE_RELOCATED (no compatibility shim needed: no importers)

production_changes_made.problem: Discovery looked only for UnrealEditor.exe, the UE5 name. CARLA 0.9.x targets UE4.26, whose Windows editor is Engine/Binaries/Win64/UE4Editor.exe, so a complete UE4.26 install was reported missing. Both tools also used next(iter((a, b)), None), which yields only the first element, so one absent candidate silently masked all later ones.
production_changes_made.fix: New discovery module searches real UE4 and UE5 names across binary subdirectories for both editor and CARLA server binaries. The build receipt now carries six independent states (UE_ENGINE_EDITOR_PRESENT, CARLA_PROJECT_COMPILED, CARLA_SERVER_BINARY_PRESENT, CARLA_RPC_RESPONSIVE, MAP_PACKAGE_COOKED, MAP_RUNTIME_LOADABLE); each is evidenced on its own and none is inferred from another, and unknown stays unknown. Preflight resource readiness is explicitly decoupled from build state.

test_changes_made.independent_audit: Confirmed as a false positive in the TEST, not in production. The test asserted the *resolved runtime value* of DEFAULT_OSM2WORLD_HOME does not contain 'c:\\users\\admin'. That default is correctly repo-relative; the checkout merely lives under C:\Users\admin, so the resolved path legitimately contains that prefix. Production path resolution was inspected and left unchanged (_resolve_default_osm2world_home precedence: env > carla_governed/ > repo-relative).
test_changes_made.fix: The test now (a) scans the source text of the three defining modules for hardcoded absolute developer-path literals and for a literal project-directory name, and (b) asserts each resolved default is anchored at the repo root (is_relative_to(REPO_ROOT)), which is what portability actually means. No xfail, no skip, no tolerance.

test_changes_made.issue: MockActor exposed neither set_transform nor apply_transform, so the module's own positive route-execution test could not exercise the governed API it was written to test (3 red tests admitted in Candidate A's commit subject).
test_changes_made.fix: MockActor now models a real CARLA actor (get_transform + set_transform). A separate MockActorNoSetTransform exposes only apply_transform, so the 'actor missing set_transform' fail-closed case still fails for the right reason. Additionally the wrong-CRS assertion was corrected to the reasons the repaired production code actually emits (manual/auto georeference CRS mismatch, manifest self-inconsistency, both_maps_share_exact_frame False), instead of a reason string that the original code could never produce.

test_changes_made.issue: The shared _manifest helper omitted crs/geo_reference. Candidate A's NEW-294 strengthening made those mandatory, so two pre-existing production tests regressed after the merge.
test_changes_made.fix: Helper supplies the canonical frame fields by default, with crs=None/geo_reference=None escapes. Added test_validate_route_manifest_requires_declared_frame asserting the NEW-294/295 requirement explicitly, so the strengthening is covered rather than bypassed.

Covers wrong LiDAR identity, inactive LiDAR activation, wrong rig hash, rig identity invariant under inactive-entry mutation, wrong calibration hash, calibration authority vs heuristic override, missing required LiDAR, wrong route frame, unresolvable CRS fail-closed, matching-frame positive case, tampered route manifest, route set_transform verification fatality, different-seed-falsely-equal-identity, same-seed determinism, unknown seed domain, missing seed domain, TM strict fallback refusal, TM unseeded refusal, TM seed-failure fail-closed, double TM ownership, explicit TM port/seed, TM world-sync mismatch, double tick ownership, weather requested-but-unbound, weather not-applied fail-closed, frame-driven weather determinism + no global RNG mutation, actor cleanup miss, sensor cleanup miss, walker mode violations, physics profile mismatch, experiment start out-of-order and in-order, run B not inheriting run A residue (seed/weather/physics/TM), TM state non-leak across runs, repeat-run reproducibility, LiDAR spec reproducibility, calibration non-mutation.

UE4.26 UE4Editor.exe discovery, UE5 UnrealEditor.exe retained deliberately, absent-first-candidate no longer masking later candidates, CARLA server discovery, compiled-project vs server-binary independence, cooked-content != runtime-loadable, and receipt states staying UNKNOWN without evidence (including CARLA_RPC_RESPONSIVE never inferred from a port).
